blocks.html:
This method adjusts the budget for each campaign associated with the promotions' specified computed actions.
It adjusts the `used` property of a `CampaignBudget` to account for the adjustment amounts in the specified associated
computed actions.

types.name: computedActions
types.description: The computed actions to adjust their promotion's campaign budget.

children.name: amount
children.description: The amount (of usage or money) to adjust the campaign budget by.

types.name: registrationContext
types.description: The context of the campaign budget usage.
